 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if g[r][c] == 0 and g[r-1][c] == g[r+1][c] == g[r][c-1] == g[r][c+1] == 2:
                centers.append((r, c))
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(centers):
        for r2, c2 in centers[i+1:]:
            if r1 == r2 and abs(c2-c1) >= 3:
                lo, hi = sorted((c1, c2))
                for c in range(lo+2, hi-1):
                    if g[r1][c] == 0:
                        g[r1][c] = 1
            elif c1 == c2 and abs(r2-r1) >= 3:
                lo, hi = sorted((r1, r2))
                for r in range(lo+2, hi-1):
                    if g[r][c1] == 0:
